import html # Predefined HTML template with named placeholders. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by: {username}

{body}
{tags}
""" def render_user_content(username_key: str, title_key: str, body_key: str, tag_elements: list[str]) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML representation of a user's forum post. Parameters ---------- username_key : str Identifier (display name) of the post's creator. title_key : str Title/heading of the user's post. body_key : str Main content/body of the post. tag_elements : list[str] List of tags to associate with the post. Returns ------- str XSS‑protected HTML string of the rendered post. Raises ------ TypeError If tag_elements is not a list. ValueError If any of the required arguments are empty or None. """ # Basic validation if not isinstance(tag_elements, list): raise TypeError("tag_elements must be a list of strings.") for tag in tag_elements: if not isinstance(tag, str): raise TypeError("Each tag must be a string.") for name, value in [("username_key", username_key), ("title_key", title_key), ("body_key", body_key)]: if not isinstance(value, str) or value == "": raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string.") # Escape all user-supplied content to prevent XSS escaped_username = html.escape(username_key, quote=True) escaped_title = html.escape(title_key, quote=True) escaped_body = html.escape(body_key, quote=False) # preserve newlines # Render each tag inside a element, escaping the tag text rendered_tags = " ".join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tag_elements ) # Format the final HTML using the predefined template return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=escaped_username, title=escaped_title, body=escaped_body.replace("\n", "
"), # preserve line breaks tags=rendered_tags )
